row: Costa Rica School of Massage Therapy

Costa Rica School of Massage Therapy (CRSMT) is a leading massage therapy school in Costa Rica and the premier study abroad program for aspiring massage therapists. CRSMT offers immersive massage therapy certification and continuing education opportunities for students and professionals. It is also home to the world’s first COMTA-accredited massage therapy study abroad training programs.

On this channel, viewers can explore what it’s like to study massage therapy abroad, hear student stories, watch our Quest for Excellence series, and get answers to common questions about the program, campus life, and admissions. The channel also highlights CRSMT’s retreat-style CEU opportunities for massage therapists looking to continue their education in Costa Rica.
